title: Research: exact rank-nine S3 convolution block screen
body:
## Result

Adds an exact rational rank-9 bilinear construction for regular convolution in the nonabelian group algebra `Q[S3]`, then screens its conditional local profile against the pinned selected complex ceiling. The algebra decomposes as `Q × Q × M2(Q)`: two scalar products plus Strassen's seven-product 2×2 matrix formula compute the six-coordinate convolution, which has 36 separate pair products. No minimum-rank theorem, selected-provider placement, supplier adoption, or new `κ` is claimed.

## Exact evidence

`RESULT.json` records all nine left and right linear forms and six-coordinate output vectors. The verifier checks the standard-representation homomorphism and exact tensor identity on all 36 group-basis pairs, 256 deterministic integer and dirty-output fixtures, output restoration, and an omitted-product negative control. The input/output transform matrices each have rational rank 6; the output coefficients have denominator at most 6. The explicit linear invoice is recorded separately from recursive child charges.

From repository root:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/complex-s3-convolution-seed8b17/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-s3-convolution-seed8b17 --check-only
```

Expected direct marker:

```text
PASS_S3_GROUP_ALGEBRA_RANK9 basis_pairs=36 integer_dirty_fixtures=256 controls=1 rank1_capacity=2412 max_blocks=67 zero_overhead_threshold=8 local_only
```

Local direct verification passed under CPython 3.14.7, including `-O`. The repository's registered research replay requires Python 3.12; that interpreter is unavailable in this environment, so only package metadata/pin check and direct replay were completed locally.

## Conditional ceiling screen and limits

One S3 block would replace 36 rank-one products by a rank-nine child, releasing 27 rank-mass units to the favorable rank-51 idle remainder. Under the pinned `m=73`, 896-family, nine-stage, centre-64 relaxation, seven ideal blocks fail the 5% ceiling target and eight pass: the candidate ceiling bracket is `[0.001775158769926, 0.001775158769927]`, against target `0.00177455681454345`. After eight blocks only one added rank-one-equivalent child total still passes; two fail.

This is a zero-implementation-charge screen. The selected trace has 2,412 rank-one children per orientation, which gives a count-only capacity of 67, but this package establishes **no actual S3 support occurrence**. The selected source/target map, scratch and frame schedule, output fanout, exact division/precision handling, hosting, restoration, and interface charges are open. The conditional profile must not be read as a realized improvement.

The package pins the exact assignment base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4, seed `8b17cb8b1a12a123db4fca0f9356197b`, and selected-record SHA-256 `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`.

## Predecessors and overlap

This uses a nonabelian matrix component, distinct from the rational C3 cyclic-convolution claim in [Discussion #2057](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2057) and the Karatsuba block claim in [Discussion #1987](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1987). The fixed selected source lineage is PR #1094. Final overlap refresh at 2026-10-15 00:27 UTC covered 455 open PRs and 911 discussions with complete pagination; exact S3/nonabelian-convolution terms found no other matching PR or discussion.

The active scope claim and handoff are in [Discussion #1167, comment 18936773](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1167#discussioncomment-18936773). Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance is disclosed in the package. New package content is Apache-2.0; frozen sources are unchanged.
